text:
A change-of-mind return costs a flat **$6.95**, which is deducted from your refund. It's free for Leafy Plus members.

A few things to keep in mind:
- This applies to non-living items only (pots, tools, soil, fertiliser, grow lights, accessories). Live plants can't be returned for change of mind.
- The item must be returned within **30 days** of delivery, unused and in its original packaging. Opened soil or fertiliser can't be returned unless faulty.
- Start the return from "My Orders". A prepaid label is emailed to you, and it expires after **7 days**, so drop the parcel off within that time.
- Your refund is issued within **5 business days** of the return reaching our warehouse, to your original payment method.

Faulty or incorrect items are returned free of charge.
